categories.main_business_segments: Jinli Group Holdings Limited primarily engages in the design, production, and sales of its own brand casual footwear products. The company operates three brands: G-apple (casual shoes), E.T (casual shoes, currently withdrawn due to market conditions), and Mei Ai Mei (beauty products, also temporarily withdrawn). The core business focuses on casual footwear with plans to expand into e-commerce sales channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes innovative and fashionable shoe design, developing products with features such as breathable materials and shock absorption. Production is mainly outsourced to external manufacturers to reduce fixed labor costs. The company maintains quality control throughout the production process and holds ISO9001:2000 certification. It also invests in R&D for product design and development, focusing on market trends and consumer preferences.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinli Group serves primarily the Chinese domestic market, targeting consumers aged 18 to 45, especially young people seeking fashionable and comfortable casual footwear. Sales are conducted mainly through agents and authorized retailers, including specialty stores, counters, and online platforms. The company’s products cater to middle-income consumers in third- and fourth-tier Chinese cities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operating region is China, with production facilities located in Fujian Province and sales concentrated in various provinces, especially third- and fourth-tier cities. It also has subsidiaries and offices in Taiwan, Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, Bermuda, and the British Virgin Islands, primarily for investment holding and brand management purposes.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinli Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the footwear supply chain. It focuses on product design, brand management, and sales, while outsourcing manufacturing to external factories. The company maintains close relationships with raw material suppliers and contract manufacturers but does not directly control upstream raw material production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes enhancing its own brand value, shifting product styles toward fashionable casual shoes, and expanding e-commerce sales channels. It plans to strengthen product design and development capabilities, innovate in footwear technology, and develop cross-industry brand products. R&D investment is aimed at responding quickly to market trends and consumer preferences, with a long-term goal of sustainable growth and brand recognition.
categories.revenue_model: Jinli Group generates revenue primarily through the sales of its own branded footwear products via agents, specialty stores, counters, and online platforms. It also earns brand licensing fees from beauty product operations, although this segment is currently inactive. The company’s revenue is derived from product sales rather than services or subscriptions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes mainly with Chinese domestic brands such as Li Ning, Anta, Xtep, and 361 Degrees in the footwear and casual apparel market. It positions itself as a mid- to low-price brand focusing on third- and fourth-tier cities, differentiating from international brands like Nike and Adidas that target higher-tier cities. Jinli Group leverages its local market knowledge and extensive distribution network to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jinli Group reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$133 million, a 36.87% decline from NT$210 million in 2023, reflecting a strategic shift from OEM to higher-margin own-brand products. The company recorded a pre-tax loss of NT$3 million, an improvement from the previous year's loss of NT$13 million. Total assets were about NT$7 billion with shareholders’ equity around NT$6.3 billion, indicating a stable financial base despite recent revenue contraction.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinli Group emphasizes high-quality, fashionable casual footwear designed to meet the lifestyle and aesthetic needs of young consumers. Its value proposition includes innovative design, product comfort, and competitive pricing positioned below major domestic and international brands. The company also focuses on building strong brand recognition through extensive agent networks, quality control, and customer engagement via e-commerce and retail channels.
